actual_wrapper.scope: bubblewrap leader first-wait4; not whole native wallet/prover tree CPU or RSS

sampling.scope: Finite external live PID/namespace/mount/FD metadata samples; short-lived processes can be missed. No private pipe bytes or FD link targets read; RSS sum is sampled concurrent tree RSS, not CPU.

terminal_cpu.scope: External live Node procfs SELF and reaped-child-chain CPU at public terminal handshake. Tick granularity; excludes unawaited/orphan processes. Waited child CPU contains Parent/helper descendants and must not be added to their nested metrics; excludes controller/native admission CLI.

retained.scope: Committed state/journal Buffer payload bytes only; excludes JS objects, allocator, staging, packet, recipients and process RSS.
